title: JRA Graded Races (2002-2025) & JBIS 5-Generation Pedigree Dataset (Bilingual JA/EN + Graph Networks)

creators.name: Mendonça, Arthur De Oliveira
creators.affiliation: Centro Federal de Educação Tecnológica de Minas Gerais (CEFET-MG)

description: Comprehensive relational and graph-ready dataset of Japanese Thoroughbred horse racing covering 24 years (2002-2025) of Japan Racing Association (JRA) Graded Races (G1, G2, G3) coupled with 5-generation genealogical pedigrees extracted from the Japan Bloodhorse Information System (JBIS). Includes both original Japanese and 100% hybrid-AI-translated English editions (SQLite3 + UTF-8 CSVs + Gephi GEXF networks). Contains 3,216 Graded races, 33,409 race entries, 8,209 unique racehorses, 8,202 direct pedigrees, and 504,074 5-generation pedigree tree nodes validated with zero broken foreign keys.
notes: Developed as an integrated project for Data Science and Algorithms & Data Structures II (AEDS 2) at CEFET-MG.
